Routing gold at h_i ALONE would be a size CUT at today's equity on the desk's only forward-evidenced book, so the sent lot is max(allocator, policy, floor): the semantic break is gone and the size can only rise. THE HEAT IDENTITY IS EXACT AND NOT APPROXIMATE. Round 2 made charge and send call one sizer; they still called it with different arguments (house nominal stop before the cap, real bracket stop at the venue), and because realised_q is LINEAR IN THE STOP the 0.02 floor could make both return the identical lot while the leg ran several times the fraction reserved -- 5.78x measured. Round 3 found three ways it was still not a universal statement: a pre-cap failure could become a send later in the same pass, the same defect lived one lane over in auto_ramp's ramped_fraction charge, and the cancel hour was checked only at the send so the cap could reserve budget for an order that could never go out. All three are closed structurally. Nothing was shrunk, capped or vetoed: the only refusal added is 'not priced before the cap, so not sent in this pass', which costs no size because the next pass prices it first, and the zero charge for an unplaceable sleeve FREES budget for sleeves that can trade. ROUND 4 CLOSED THE SCALP LANE. It was the one lane still billed a requested fraction, and it needed a refactor rather than an extraction: the executor interleaved the entry decision with live basket state. Every lane that sends an order now resolves and prices it before the cap; the `from_book` fraction branch is reached by no sending lane at all.

ROUND 3 ADDED THE CONFOUNDER-AWARE HALF. Transfer entropy conditions on the TARGET'S OWN history; the audit was right that the target's other admitted parents were still handled only by the regression-based conditional_information. Nonlinear I(X;Y | other admitted parents of Y) is now computed beside that deltaR2, on the same sample and the same lags, and it is annotation-only exactly as TE is: the conditional STATUS remains the deltaR2's.

status_vocabulary_note: LANDED means the code exists in THIS REPOSITORY, on a named clock, with an artifact and a consumer. It does NOT mean the artifact has ever been produced on the trading box, and it does not mean the behaviour has been observed with money at risk. That distinction is what the five acceptance_properties measure, and they are measured from artifacts rather than asserted: an absent artifact reads UNMEASURED, never MET. Read the census as build coverage and the acceptance properties as operational proof. They are different questions and the second is the one that decides whether the desk works.
